machine.gpu_note: The exact kernel is irregular integer bitset enumeration and bounded vertex-cover DFS; a Metal/GPU port would add dispatch and transfer overhead without changing the bottleneck.

index_order_check.method: Regenerate n=14 with the same Mac triangleramsey/filter pipeline and compare byte-for-byte with the independently committed Windows-generated corpus.

exact_results.note: Every previous exact rejection in the deferred population is also rejected by the bounded-cover rule. The tight-cover rule fires four times in the deferred population, with two outside the old cover set. Both Hall filters are redundant with the corpus K8 exclusion, as proved and independently witnessed.

reference_crosscheck.selection: fixed SplitMix64 pool of 2048 corpus indices, retaining 16 graphs in each of K7-certified, K7-deferred, and K6-only-deferred, plus four explicitly labeled tight-rule witnesses

sample_rejections.targeted_tight_matching: 4/4 (including 2/4 not rejected by the old cover rule)

heuristic_obstruction_pilot.status: Containment hits of the eight remaining patterns are heuristic until the patterns receive separate rigorous non-realizability certificates.

trust: The new filters use exact integer graph operations and never force candidate nonedges to be non-unit. The bounded-cover cardinality and tight-frame equality proofs use the validated almost-equidistant precondition alpha(G)<=2. The f(4)=12 and f(5)=16 link inputs inherit their respective computer-assisted proof assumptions. No floating-point geometric decision is made.
